To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Google matrix of directed networks can be reduced to a simple form, which allows inferring hidden relations between the members and the structure of these relations can be re-programmed as a result changes in the transcription layer.
the reduced Google matrix method is a novel approach that allows inferring hidden causality in biological networks.

We suggest a novel Googlomics methodology for the structural analysis and the inference of hidden causal relations between members of a signaling network using spectral analysis of its reduced Google matrix.

a new approach to the study of the global structure of biological networks and the hidden causal relations between its members.
the development of a novel methodology for the structural analysis and the inference of hidden causal relations in directed biological networks.
the development of a new methodology for analyzing the causal structure of biological networks.

the reduced Google matrix method is a powerful tool for the analysis of the structure of biological networks and the inference of hidden causal relations between their members.
the Googlomics approach provides a powerful new methodology for the study of the structure of large directed networks in general and of the structure of biological networks in particular.

the Google matrix method provides new tools for the structural analysis, modeling and control of large directed networks in various fields of physics, biology and other sciences, and that Googlomics provides a new tool for the analysis of large directed biological networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we suggest an efficient methodology for a new type of network biology, called Googlomic biology, for a quantitative analysis of complex directed biological networks.
Googlomics is a new methodology which allows the analysis of complex biological networks in terms of their hidden causal relations and their structural reprogramming during development and disease.
Googlomics is a powerful new tool for the structural analysis and the reprogramming of large causal biological systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Googlomics is a powerful tool for the analysis of complex biological networks and can be useful for the study of signaling pathways and other functional groups of genes in normal and pathological states.
Google matrices provide a new powerful tool for the analysis of complex biological networks and for inferring their hidden causal structure.
